name: orb15-vwap
title: 15-minute opening-range breakout, above VWAP
description: Buy the first 5-minute close above the opening range's high while price is above the session VWAP, between 09:30 and 11:30 IST. Stop at the range's midpoint, target 2R, flat by the safe flat-by. The setup trader-entry watches for, as a testable spec.
references: Toby Crabel, Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and Opening Range Breakout (1990)
